_readme: A fight against a FORMATION, played. Everything BattleLogic proves about a crowd is
proved there; what only a played fight can show is that the crowd reaches the player -
that a spell can sweep both of them, that the cursor asks which one and the blow lands
where it was pointed, and that the fight pays for what it killed rather than for one of
The route: fetch Rook, clear both hollow slinks the ordinary way, and that is level 2 -
which is exactly when Gale arrives. The pair is in the same room, in the north-west
pocket, so the tool and the thing it is for turn up together.
Its tile was MEASURED, not chosen. A probe on the tile-change hook logged every tile all
eighteen sessions walk; (2,1) is reachable from row 3 and none of its four neighbours is
ever stepped on, which is why adding it moved no other script by a frame.
The spell page at level 2 is Ember, Mend, Gale, Lull - sorted by the level that hands
them over and then by name - so Gale is two rows down. Counted, and the count is written
here because inserting a spell moves it.
The xp is the assertion that says the award SUMS: the pair pays 5 for the slink and 12
for the gloom, and 27 in total carries both members from 2 to 3. A fight that paid for
one of them would read 20 and stop at level 2.

steps.text: fetch Rook: south to the well, west to the wall, south to her
north up the wall and through the west door; the hold carries past the warp, so the next leg re-anchors on the hollow's own geometry
the two ordinary slinks, mashed - they are not what this script is about, they are how it reaches level 2
a fight stops you where you stood, which is rarely a tile centre and the gap below is one tile wide - so re-anchor on the west wall, then three tiles east puts us squarely on the gap's column

20 xp where this used to read 10, because both hollow fights are pairs now - and STILL exactly level 2, because the curve doubled with them. The gold is unchanged at 8, which is the check that the halving was done right: twice the bodies at half the coin is the same purse.

and now into the pocket, which is the long way round: the wall below is solid but for the one gap, so back to its column, north through it until the pool stops us, west along the row above the gap, and north up the west side. Arriving at [1,1] puts the pair on the right.
Gale first, and it asks nobody: rows are Attack, Magic, Item, Flee, so one down opens the page, and the page at level 2 is Ember, Mend, Gale, Lull - two more downs.
and now Rook, who gets the cursor: two foes still standing, so the swing asks which. One down is the gloom - the second thing the record named.
the rest of it mashed - a masher always takes the first foe still standing, which is the slink
the award SUMS the formation: 5 for the slink and 12 for the gloom on top of the 20 the hollow already paid. Paying for one would read 25 or 32.

and this pocket no longer buys a level, where it used to. THIS FIGHT DID NOT CHANGE - it was already a pair in M28 - so the doubled curve moved past it while every fight that grew kept pace. That is deliberate rather than overlooked: the optional fight the design promises a level for is the CAVE, whose pair pays exactly one curve step, and test_battle_content pins that. This one is a bonus, and 37 is seven short of level 3.

and the purse, summed the same way: 2 and 3 on top of the hollow's 8. Halved, for the same reason the level is short - the bodies here did not double, so holding a fight's payout steady did not apply to it.
